_README: Per-model presentation data. Zeke 2026-08-28: 'some of the 3d objects should be
rotated like the heart and what not and the star, also if it's not head shaped it
rot  : [rx, ry, rz] degrees, baked into the mesh once at load time. glTF has no
'upright' convention, so authors model in whatever pose they like.
head : true = this reads as a HEAD, so --nod tilts it chin-down on the beat.
Everything else gets a size pulse instead. A torus knot has no chin.
flat : true = essentially 2-D (heart, star, bolt, disc). A continuous 360 spin
turns these edge-on for half of every revolution and they vanish, so
flat models get a gentle +/- oscillation instead of a full rotation.
Kept SEPARATE from manifest.json because build_model_manifest rewrites that file
wholesale and would silently wipe hand-tuned poses.
